description: Editorial notes, owner decisions of 2026-10-16 (opensiddur-processor specs/asher_selichot/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md). The build places each as a tei:anchor after its `before` text, with a standoff tei:note type="editorial" targeting it; a book prints them when it lists the English project under annotations. Each begins "Editor:" so it is never mistaken for one of the book's own notes.

notes.before: If the Eve of New Moon is on Sabbath or Sunday the Psalm, page 190, is said instead of the following—
notes.text: Editor: page 190 gives this exception as “when the New Moon is on Sabbath or Sunday”, the days on which the fast is held on Thursday; that is probably what is meant here.

notes.before: bring them unto thy holy mountain
notes.text: Editor: Isaiah lvi. 7 reads “my holy mountain” (הַר קָדְשִׁי).
